title: 伯克希尔60年首破例：增持梅西至700万股，为何押注这家百货？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Yep, we want to start with Alibaba, ticker symbol, B-A-B-A. Stocks up about one and a half percent here in the pre-market. So it's selling its gaming arm unit. It's a deal worth one and a half
segments.zh: 首先关注阿里巴巴，权益资产代码BABA，盘前上涨约1.5%。公司出售游戏业务，交易价值15亿美元。

segments.en: billion, and it's going to help Alibaba pivot to artificial intelligence. So who's buying this gaming arm? It's an Asian private equity firm, trust our capital. We don't know the price they paid,
segments.zh: 这将助力阿里巴巴转向人工智能。买家是亚洲私募股权公司，具体价格未披露。

segments.en: but Bloomberg reports the transaction may value that gaming studio at more than one and a half billion.
segments.zh: 但彭博报道，该游戏工作室估值可能超过15亿美元。

segments.en: Alibaba is sort of undergoing this broader restructuring under their CEO Eddie Wu, their divesting their non-core assets, they're making AI cloud computing really a top priority at the
segments.zh: 阿里巴巴在CEO吴泳铭领导下进行重组，剥离非核心资产，将AI云计算列为重中之重。

segments.en: company. And this month, actually Alibaba, you'll remember, we talked about it, they released their biggest ever AI model. They claim performance on par with Anthropics. So that's huge for Alibaba,
segments.zh: 本月阿里巴巴发布了史上最大AI模型，性能媲美Anthropic，这对公司意义重大。

segments.en: as they continue to make inroads there. Yep, very good. Let's move over to Macy's, ticker symbol, M simply put, it is up half a percent. So not a major mover, but I bring this up because Berkshire
segments.zh: 再看梅西百货，权益资产代码M，上涨0.5%，涨幅不大，但伯克希尔·哈撒韦增持了股份。

segments.en: Halfaway has more than doubled its stake in Macy's to seven million shares. Why is that so important?
segments.zh: 伯克希尔将其持股翻倍至700万股，为何重要？

segments.en: Because Berkshire Halfaway, up until a few months ago, had not made an investment in a public department store, get this in 60 years. So kidding. Yeah. So they bought this stake in Macy's and they
segments.zh: 因为伯克希尔60年来首次**百货公司，如今增持梅西，显示其看好。

segments.en: seemed to be doubling down on it. Macy's a lot of analysts are saying the companies in this recovery mode, they had a giant beat on adjusted earnings per share recently. But if you look at it just from
segments.zh: 分析师认为梅西处于复苏模式，近期调整后每股收益大幅超预期，但股价较11年前峰值已跌去一半。

segments.en: a stock standpoint, their peak was 11 years ago. They've lost around half their value. But you know,
segments.zh: 从股价看，峰值在11年前，如今市值缩水约一半。
